### What does this PR do? Currently, `RLHFDataset` first retrieves the raw prompt as a string here: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/327e813136c117a564f99995f6000dc685b19351/verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py#L235-L237 https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/327e813136c117a564f99995f6000dc685b19351/verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py#L283-L285 and later obtains `input_ids` by invoking the processor again here: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/327e813136c117a564f99995f6000dc685b19351/verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py#L258-L261 https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/327e813136c117a564f99995f6000dc685b19351/verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py#L286-L288 However, both of these operations prepend a BOS token, resulting in duplication. This PR fixes the issue by removing the leading BOS token from the input of the second invocation.
> [!NOTE] > We should not remove the bos token from the raw prompt itself, since it is used later here: > https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/327e813136c117a564f99995f6000dc685b19351/verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py#L335 ### Checklist Before Starting - [x] Search for similar PRs. ## Code Review

This pull request aims to fix an issue with duplicated beginning-of-sequence (BOS) tokens in the `RLHFDataset`. The change correctly removes the prefix BOS token before tokenization. However, the implementation is not robust against tokenizers that do not have a `bos_token` defined, which could lead to a runtime error. My review includes a critical fix to prevent this potential crash.

![critical](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/critical.svg)

The `self.tokenizer.bos_token` can be `None` for some tokenizers. In such cases, `raw_prompt.removeprefix(self.tokenizer.bos_token)` will raise a `TypeError`, causing the data loading to crash. To make this more robust, you should handle the case where `bos_token` is `None`.

```suggestion
                text=[raw_prompt.removeprefix(self.tokenizer.bos_token or "")],
```

                 # link: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/3c545c0c3b98ee642373a308197d750d0e449403/vllm/multimodal/parse.py#L205

@@ -283,7 +288,11 @@ def __getitem__(self, item):
             raw_prompt = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
                 messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False, **self.apply_chat_template_kwargs
             )
-            model_inputs = self.tokenizer(raw_prompt, return_tensors="pt", add_special_tokens=False)
+            model_inputs = self.tokenizer(
+                raw_prompt.removeprefix(self.tokenizer.bos_token or ""),
+                return_tensors="pt",
+                add_special_tokens=False,
+            )
